title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Spending Pass Ride Credit and Its Expiry After Cancellation
content:
# Spending Pass ride credit and its expiry after cancellation

These terms of Wayfare Pass (rider membership) fix, for every plan, what Pass ride credit can pay for and how long unspent credit survives once a membership has been cancelled.

| Plan | What Pass ride credit can pay for | Unspent credit is forfeited this many calendar days after the date the membership was cancelled |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | fares (the fare charge) | 90 |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | fares (the fare charge) | 90 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | fares (the fare charge) | 90 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | fares (the fare charge) | 90 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | fares (the fare charge) | 90 |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | fares (the fare charge) | 90 |

## Terms in clause form

1. On every plan, Pass ride credit can pay for the fare charge only.
2. On every plan, unspent credit is forfeited 90 calendar days after the date the membership was cancelled.

## Questions answered

- *Can Pass ride credit pay a tip, a toll or a cancellation fee?* No. The only thing listed is the fare charge.
- *Does the expiry figure differ between monthly and annual plans?* No. It is 90 calendar days on all six plans.
